plain.li: [spark:nemesis] I know the face now. I know the name. I'm going to see it in the ground.
[hurt] Every time the wound aches, I think about who gave it to me. I've decided to stop just thinking.
[night] I lie awake planning it. Not the details. Just the moment where it's over.
I used to want a lot of things. Now I want one.

warm.li: I don't want to hate anyone. But I won't sleep properly until the one who did this can't do it again.

blunt.li: Somebody hurt me and walked away. That doesn't get to stand.

cheerful.li: My new plan is to outlive the person who tried to kill me! Ideally because they're dead.

gloomy.li: Either I end it or it ends me, and I know which is likelier. I'm going to try anyway.

cold.li: An open matter. I prefer my matters closed.

plain.li: It's over. I touched the scar this morning and it was only a scar.
I slept a whole night. I didn't know I'd forgotten how.

warm.li: It's done. I hope I never have to feel like that about anyone again.

gloomy.li: My nemesis is dead. There'll be another one someday, but this one's done.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: known far and wide
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: make friends among travelers and guests

plain.li: Everyone who comes through here has a story. I'd like to hear theirs, and have them remember mine.
[skill:Social] I'm going to be the one visitors ask for by name.
[small] It's a small colony. The world isn't. I'd like to know some of it.

warm.li: I want every traveler who stops here to leave with a full stomach and a reason to come back.

blunt.li: Strangers are just people I haven't argued with yet. Time to fix that.

cheerful.li: A friend in every caravan, and a free sample from every trader!

gloomy.li: Everyone here will die eventually. Maybe the people on the road will remember us.

cold.li: Contacts outside the colony are an asset. I intend to collect them.

plain.li: A visitor asked for me by name today. Not the colony. Me.
Half the caravans on this road know my face now. Some of them even like it.

warm.li: I have friends in places I've never been. That's a strange, good feeling.

cheerful.li: I'm famous, in a small way! I'll take it.

cold.li: A reliable network of acquaintances. Useful, and, I admit, pleasant.
